metadata.Name: JDocQA
metadata.Description: A large-scale Japanese document-based QA dataset requiring both visual and textual information to answer questions.
Provider: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Paper Title: JDocQA: Japanese Document Question Answering Dataset for Generative Language Models
Affiliations: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Abstract: Document question answering is a task of question answering on given documents such as reports, slides, pamphlets, and websites. We introduce Japanese Document Question Answering (JDocQA), a large-scale document-based QA dataset, requiring both visual and textual information to answer questions. It comprises 5,504 documents in PDF format and annotated 11,600 question-and-answer instances in Japanese. We empirically evaluate the effectiveness of our dataset with text-based large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models.
